concerns.text: T009a (Generate SHA-256 checksum) is listed as dependent on T009c (Create human_annotations.json), but T009a is placed BEFORE T009c in the task list. A consumer (checksum generation) cannot precede its producer (file creation). T009a must be moved after T009c.

T019 (Regeneration loop) explicitly states 'Depends on T020 and T021'. However, T020 (Create probes.jsonl writer) and T021 (Error handling) are listed AFTER T019 in the sequence. The regeneration loop logic (T019) cannot be implemented before the writer (T020) and error handling (T021) it depends on. T019 must be moved after T020 and T021.

T026a (Aggregate consistency scores) states 'Depends on T032, T025, T026, T028'. T032 (Create results.jsonl writer) is listed AFTER T026a. The aggregation logic cannot write to or depend on a writer that hasn't been defined yet. T026a must be moved after T032.

T033 (Run statistical test) depends on T031 (Select statistical test), which in turn depends on T030 (Check normality). T030 reads from 'data/derived/results.jsonl'. T032 (Create results.jsonl writer) is listed AFTER T030. The normality check (T030) cannot read from a file that the writer (T032) hasn't been created to populate yet. T030 and T031 must be moved after T032.

The Foundational Phase lists T009b, T009c, and T009a as [P] (parallel-safe). However, T009a explicitly depends on T009c (checksum of the file created in T009c). T009c creates the file, T009a checksums it. They cannot run in parallel. The [P] tag on T009a is incorrect, and the ordering must be sequential (T009c -> T009a).
